description:
Rooney Auctioneers are delighted to present No. 19 Castletroy Heights, Golf Links Road, Castletroy, Limerick to the market.

This superb and spacious residence is ideally positioned on a private cul-de-sac residential avenue, occupying a generous and beautifully maintained private site in one of Castletroy’s most sought-after residential locations.

The property has been extensively upgraded and completely renovated in recent years, offering a wonderful turnkey opportunity for prospective purchasers. Improvements include new windows and doors, a modern new kitchen, upgraded bathrooms, beautifully finished hallway and upgraded bedroom accommodation, combining contemporary finishes with generous living space throughout.

The ground floor provides three excellent reception rooms, offering exceptional flexibility for modern family living, entertaining, home working or relaxation. To the rear, the property benefits from a rear utility room, while the attic has also been upgraded, with stira stairs to the partially floored attic which also benefits  from electricity and provides  excellent potential for extra storage or future conversion, subject to the necessary planning requirements.

To the front, the property benefits from a double private driveway, providing ample off-street parking. To the rear is a beautifully landscaped, long and private south-facing garden, featuring a patio area and a block-built storage shed. The shed offers excellent potential and could readily be adapted for use as a home office, gym or additional recreational space, subject to requirements.
No. 19 Castletroy Heights enjoys an enviable location within easy reach of an abundance of amenities, including the University of Limerick, Castletroy College, Monaleen National School and Milford National School.

Residents are exceptionally well served by Castletroy Shopping Centre, together with a wide selection of local shops, cafés, restaurants and leisure facilities.
For outdoor and sporting enthusiasts, Castletroy Golf Club and Castletroy Park are both nearby, while the property also benefits from excellent connectivity, with easy access to the M7 motorway and all major road networks.

No. 19 Castletroy Heights represents a superb opportunity to acquire a substantial and extensively upgraded family home in one of Limerick’s premier residential locations. Combining generous and versatile accommodation, a private south-facing rear garden, extensive recent upgrades and excellent potential for further use of the attic and rear storage space, this property is ideally suited to moder living and should attract strong interest from prospective purchasers.

Additional Features

Built 1970
Large site to rear for further extension if required 
Outdoor lighting
Oil fired heating system with smart controls.
Mains water and sewage
Double-glazed PVC windows
Large block built shed - ample storage
Carpets, curtains, blinds, light fittings & appliances included. 

Overall Floor Area
Approx. 105.9 sq. m. (1140sq. ft)


The accommodation comprises a bright and welcoming entrance hallway  with a convenient guest WC with whb vanity unit and wc, fully tiled. There are two bright and spacious reception rooms, interconnected by sliding doors, providing excellent flexibility for family living and entertaining.

The front reception room (4.19m x 3.24m) is a bright and relaxing space, featuring beautiful wood flooring and a feature open fireplace. Sliding doors lead through to the rear reception room (3.87m x 3.78m  which is filled with natural light and enjoys a lovely sunny aspect. This room is also enhanced by wood flooring and a feature fireplace, creating a warm and inviting living space.

To the rear of the property, the bright open-plan kitchen and breakfast area (4.17m x 3.58m) overlooks the private rear garden and provides an excellent hub for everyday family life. A large and bright front dining room,( 4.73m x 2.48m) located off the kitchen, creates an ideal space for formal dining and entertaining. Recessed spotlights. Sliding doors off. 

On the first floor, there are three spacious bedrooms, including the main bedroom (4.53m x 3.80m) with ensuite off (1.71m x 0.89m), together with two further bedrooms measuring approximately (4.56 x 3.46m) and (3.15m x 2.41m) 
A well-appointed and fully tiled family bathroom (2.21m x 1.75m) with whb vanity unit, wc, bath with shower (electric) & fully tiled completes the first-floor accommodation.

The property also benefits from a spacious attic space, accessed via a stira stairs. The attic is partially floored and benefits from electricity, providing excellent additional storage and potential for a variety of uses, subject to the necessary planning requirements.
